raw.query: SELECT model, mode, variate, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END)::numeric, 4) AS w_h1, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END)::numeric, 4) AS w_h12, ROUND(((MAX(CASE WHEN h=12 THEN wape END) - MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN h=1 THEN wape END) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS rel_pct FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE resolution = '45s' AND span = 'common' AND candidate = 'point' AND model IN ('chronos', 'timesfm', 'toto') GROUP BY model, mode, variate ORDER BY model, mode, variate;
raw.observed: For all three foundation models (chronos, timesfm, toto) at 45s resolution (where 12 steps covers the 9-minute median burst onset), relative WAPE change from h=1 to h=12 across all 4 variates is between -1.09% and +4.38%.
raw.claimed: accuracy degrades only marginally across a twelve-step horizon covering the median burst onset
raw.evidence: At the 45s resolution where a twelve-step horizon matches the 9-minute median burst onset (12*45s = 540s = 9 min), the relative WAPE change from h=1 to h=12 for all three foundation models across all four variates is ≤4.38%.
